description: Baseline health checks for this cluster: infrastructure, database, application, reliability, security and cost.

panels.title: Nodes Not Ready
panels.description: Nodes not reporting Ready.

panels.title: OOM Kills (24h)
panels.description: Containers killed for exceeding their memory limit in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Volumes >85% Full
panels.description: Persistent volume claims more than 85% used.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Rate
panels.description: Share of ingress requests returning a server error.

panels.title: Backups Failing
panels.description: Backup schedules whose most recent run did not succeed.

panels.title: Certs Expiring <30d
panels.description: Certificates expiring within 30 days.

panels.title: Pods Not Running
panels.description: Pods stuck in Failed or Pending.

panels.title: Spend (month to date)
panels.description: Cloud spend so far this month.

panels.title: Node Ready Status
panels.description: Ready status per node. 1 is Ready, 0 is NotReady.

panels.title: Node Conditions
panels.description: Nodes reporting memory, disk, PID or network pressure.

panels.title: Node CPU Utilisation
panels.description: CPU used per node, as a share of that node's cores. Where node-exporter cannot run, falls back to the kubelet's /metrics/resource endpoint measured against node capacity. That is a different denominator to per-CPU idle time, so two clusters can read a few points apart.

targets.expr:
(1 - avg by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
(sum by (node) (rate(node_cpu_usage_seconds_total[$__rate_interval]))
   / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="cpu"}))

panels.title: Node Memory Utilisation
panels.description: Memory used per node. Where node-exporter cannot run, falls back to the kubelet's working set measured against node capacity. Working set is not MemTotal minus MemAvailable, since it excludes reclaimable page cache, so the fallback usually reads a little lower.

targets.expr:
(1 - (sum by (node) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / sum by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)))
or
(sum by (node) (node_memory_working_set_bytes)
   / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Container OOM Kill Events
panels.description: Containers killed for exceeding their memory limit, by pod.

panels.title: Containers in a Bad State Now
panels.description: Containers whose last exit was an OOM kill, and containers currently in CrashLoopBackOff.

defaults.noValue: No OOM kills or crash loops

panels.title: Pods per Node
panels.description: Pods scheduled per node against that node's pod capacity. Counted from kube-state-metrics, which labels by node name directly.

panels.title: Why this row can be empty

options.content: These panels come from the `prometheus-node-exporter` DaemonSet, which needs `hostNetwork`, `hostPID` and a host root filesystem mount. Managed nodepools such as GKE Autopilot and EKS Fargate do not permit it, so on those clusters these panels stay empty and node-level disk, filesystem and saturation data is only available from the cloud provider's own monitoring. CPU, memory and pod density in the row above fall back to the kubelet and keep working.

panels.title: Node Uptime
panels.description: Time since each node booted. A drop to zero is a reboot or, on spot pools, an eviction and replacement.

panels.title: Load per Core
panels.description: 5-minute load average divided by that node's core count. Sustained values above 1 mean work is queueing for CPU.

panels.title: Pressure Stall (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time work was stalled waiting for CPU, memory or IO. Rises before utilisation looks alarming, so it is the earliest saturation signal.

panels.title: Root Filesystem Used %
panels.description: Root filesystem usage per node. NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp alerts on the same data before it runs out.

panels.title: Conntrack and File Descriptors
panels.description: Two limits that stop a node serving traffic long before CPU or memory run out, and which are easy to miss.

panels.title: Node Disk Saturation (I/O time)
panels.description: Share of time each disk spent busy with I/O. Sustained values near 100% mean requests are queueing.

panels.title: Node Disk IOPS
panels.description: Disk read and write operations per second.

panels.title: Node Disk Throughput
panels.description: Disk bytes read and written per second.

panels.title: Volume Utilisation %
panels.description: Current usage of each persistent volume claim. Orange from 75%, red from 85%.

panels.title: Volume Utilisation over time
panels.description: Volume usage over time. The slope shows which volumes are filling, and how fast.

panels.title: Request Rate by Status Class
panels.description: Ingress request rate, split by response status.

panels.title: 5xx Error Rate & 4xx Rate
panels.description: Error rates as a share of all ingress traffic. 404s are excluded from the 4xx line.

panels.title: Request Volume vs 30m Baseline (anomaly)
panels.description: Request rate over the last 5 minutes against the last 30. 1.0 is steady traffic.

panels.title: 4xx Spikes by Service
panels.description: Client errors per 5 minutes by backend service, excluding 404s.

panels.title: DB CPU / Sessions / Storage %
panels.description: Azure SQL load and disk utilisation. All three are percentages of the same database, so one axis is correct.

panels.title: DB Connection Failures & Deadlocks
panels.description: Failed connections and deadlocks per 5 minutes.

options.content:
These panels need an Azure SQL metrics exporter and stay empty without one.

Full database detail is on the **Azure SQL Health** dashboard.

panels.title: Backup Status by Schedule
panels.description: Result of the most recent backup per schedule, and how long since the last success.

panels.title: Backup Attempts vs Failures
panels.description: Backup runs over time by outcome. Partial failures finish, but the backup is incomplete.

panels.title: Errors on Deployed Tooling
panels.description: Infrastructure components not running: crash loops, image pull failures and config errors.

panels.title: Restarts of Deployed Tooling
panels.description: Restart events for infrastructure components.

panels.title: Days Until Certificate Expiry
panels.description: Remaining validity of each certificate. A renewal shows as a step back up.

panels.title: Certificates Expiring Soonest
panels.description: Certificates ranked by expiry. Orange under 30 days, red under 7.

targets.expr: sort(min by (secret_namespace, secret_name, subject_CN, issuer_CN) ((x509_cert_not_after - time()) / 86400))

panels.title: Daily Cloud Spend
panels.description: Cloud spend per calendar day.

panels.title: Spend Rate vs 7-Day Average (spike detection)
panels.description: Spend over the last 24 hours against the 7-day daily average. 1.0 is normal. Resets at the start of each month.

list.label: Namespace
list.description: Limits the workload panels. Node, HTTP, backup, certificate and cost panels are cluster-wide.

list.description: Namespaces holding the platform components covered by the Reliability section.
